title.en: the vancouver christmas market at jack poole plaza.
title.de: der vancouver christmas market am jack poole plaza.
title.tr: jack poole plaza'da vancouver christmas market.

line.en: the market runs to 24 december; weekday hours are 16:00 to 21:30 through 4 december, beside the convention centre.
line.de: der markt läuft bis 24. dezember; werktags 16 bis 21:30 uhr bis 4. dezember, neben dem convention centre.
line.tr: market 24 aralık'a kadar açık; 4 aralığa kadar hafta içi 16:00 ile 21:30 arası, convention centre'ın yanında.

sparks.why: Vancouver Christmas Market at Jack Poole Plaza, 1055 Canada Place, 16 Nov to 24 Dec 2026 per Daily Hive (Sep 2026); weekday hours 16:00 to 21:30 to 4 Dec per Vancouver's Best Places. Friday hours not separately confirmed; check vancouverchristmasmarket.com.
